picks.headline: Robotic surgery: How much will your health insurance policy actually pay? - Business Standard
picks.angle: Read the fine print of your health insurance policy to understand what treatments are covered before an emergency happens.
facts: How much will your health insurance policy actually pay?
picks.avoid: Do not predict future costs or claim that certain insurance companies are better than others.

picks.headline: Credit card spending rises 20% to ₹2.45 lakh crore in October as festive shopping boosts consumer demand across India - Livemint
picks.angle: High festive spending is a common trap; learn to track your credit card usage to ensure your monthly debt payments remain manageable.
facts: Credit card spending rises 20% to ₹2.45 lakh crore
picks.avoid: Do not frame spending as negative or positive, and avoid giving advice on whether to use credit cards or not.

picks.headline: Gold loans grow 60.6% to ₹2.33 trillion, ticket size up 32.7%: Report - Business Standard
picks.angle: Before taking a loan against any asset like gold, calculate if the interest cost fits your budget and understand the risks of default.
picks.avoid: Do not recommend gold loans as an easy solution or judge people for using them; avoid suggesting specific lenders.

general_picks.headline: Black Friday Sales
general_picks.story: iPhone 17 Pro Max under Rs 97,000, iPhone 16 under Rs 46,000: Croma Black Friday deals - The Indian Express
general_picks.why_popular: Major discounts on electronics like iPhones are trending across India as the sale season begins.
general_picks.bridge: Just like a big sale, your money needs a 'wishlist' strategy so you don't overspend on impulse buys.
general_picks.hook: POV: You have a sale-proof shopping plan
facts: Major brands are offering significant price drops on the latest smartphone models.
Sales are currently driving high traffic to both online and physical retail stores.
general_picks.avoid: Do not imply that buying these items on sale is a smart financial investment or a way to save money.

general_picks.headline: Daily Wordle Puzzle
general_picks.story: Today’s NYT Wordle Hints, Answer and Help for Friday, Nov. 27, #1987 - CNET
general_picks.why_popular: Thousands of people search for hints and answers to the daily word puzzle every single morning.
general_picks.bridge: Solving your daily money habits is like playing Wordle—a little bit of consistent daily effort eventually reveals the big picture.
general_picks.hook: If consistency was a money habit
facts: Wordle remains a daily habit for millions of users worldwide.
The game challenges players to solve a puzzle with limited attempts.
general_picks.avoid: Do not frame financial health as a game of luck or chance.

general_picks.headline: Scheduled Messages
general_picks.story: WhatsApp users can also schedule messages now - News On AIR
general_picks.why_popular: The feature to schedule messages on WhatsApp has recently become a widely used tool for better communication.
general_picks.bridge: Just like you can schedule a message, you can automate your 'savings' message to yourself every payday.
general_picks.hook: Things that just make sense: Automating your savings
facts: WhatsApp now allows users to schedule messages for both individual and group chats.
This feature helps users manage their communication timing more effectively.
general_picks.avoid: Do not suggest using automated banking apps or specific high-risk investment platforms.
